placeholder.title: Run observability
placeholder.description: Recorded runs of this Bot will be listed here once the observability store is connected. Nothing is missing from the Bot itself.

disabled.title: Run tracing is off
disabled.description: Observability is disabled for this deployment, so no runs are recorded. Existing Bot execution is unaffected.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.description: This Bot has not recorded a run. Start a conversation, then reload this page.

forbidden.title: You cannot observe this Bot
forbidden.description: Observation needs management rights on the Bot. Being able to chat with it, or a public share link, is not enough.

basic.title: Basic coverage only
basic.description: Only what OpenBot itself observed is recorded. Steps inside this remote Agent are not visible, and their absence is not evidence they did not happen.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: This field could not be handled safely, so only metrics are shown. Omitted is not the same as empty.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: This value exceeds the recorded size limit and was cut. The stored record is shorter than what the run actually produced.

syncing.title: Still syncing
syncing.description: The run finished but its record has not been confirmed upstream yet. Reload shortly.

unavailable.title: Upstream unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer. Your conversation result was not affected. This is a fault, not an empty list.
